title: Evaluating LLMs for Historical Document OCR: A Methodological Framework for Digital Humanities

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the "Archaic Insertion Rate" (AIR) to quantify "over-historicization" (the systematic insertion of obsolete characters from incorrect historical periods) and the "Historical Character Preservation Rate" (HCPR) to assess fidelity to period-specific orthography.

Analyzing correlations between document subjects (e.g., religion, science, fiction) and specific error types to determine if models apply different orthographic standards or stereotypes based on the text's genre.
